HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

3. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

10. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

13. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

15. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Global diversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
